items.title: Vietnam detains deputy agriculture minister in durian export probe - The Straits Times
items.summary: China is Vietnam’s largest destination for durian export. * Vietnamese police detained Deputy Agriculture Minister Hoang Trung and three others for alleged bribery and corruption linked to durian export policies benefiting vested interests. Vietnamese police detained four people, including the deputy minister of agriculture and environment, on allegations of accepting bribes as part of an expanding investigation into corruption linked to durian exports to China. Deputy minister Hoang Trung is accused of abusing his position by issuing illegal policies, including allegedly creating “sub-licences” to serve vested interests and generate “particularly large” illicit gains linked to durian exports, according to a statement on the Ministry of Public Security’s website. The alleged breaches caused “serious damage” to the legitimate rights and interests of durian growers and export businesses, resulting in “exceptionally” large losses to the state budget and “negatively” impacting the reputation of the entire Vietnamese agricultural sector, the statement said.

items.title: The Vietnam Self-Storage Boom: An Overview of This Southeast Asia Market and Predictions for the Future - Inside Self-Storage
items.summary: # The Vietnam Self-Storage Boom: An Overview of This Southeast Asia Market and Predictions for the Future. In Vietnam, the gap between the amount of stuff people own and the space they have to accommodate it keeps widening, fueling demand for self-storage units. Though the industry is still developing in this country, there’s vast potential for expansion. In this article, the founder of local operator MyStorage shares an insider’s view of market conditions and what he sees as the future of the sector. When I founded MyStorage in Ho Chi Minh City in 2019, it was based on the observation that Vietnam’s cities were growing fast, but the homes weren’t getting any larger. In the 2025 Asia-Pacific (APAC) Self-Storage Annual Report published by commercial real estate firm JLL and the Self Storage Association Asia, Vietnam was identified as a “developing market,” which means it has 15 to 50 square feet of rentable space per 1,000 urban residents.

items.title: Industrial realty poised to grasp FDI - Vietnam Investment Review - VIR
items.summary: Vietnam’s industrial real estate market is entering its next phase of growth, driven by high-quality investment inflows and the transition towards greener development. The recovery in foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows is expected to further drive demand for industrial land leases and production expansion across industrial parks (IPs) in the coming period. “As Vietnam’s industrial real estate market enters a new growth cycle, the ability to develop eco-IPs that meet environmental standards, alongside infrastructure quality and the capacity to attract high-tech manufacturing projects, will become the key factors determining each developer’s competitive advantage. According to CBRE Vietnam, Ho Chi Minh City’s industrial market is also witnessing a shift in the composition of FDI inflows. Corporate CEO Talk Biz Link PR Newswire Media OutReach Newswire. items.title: LG ELECTRONICS STRENGTHENS GLOBAL SUPPLY CHAIN FOR ADVANCED ANTIMICROBIAL MATERIALS - Financial Times
items.summary: ### LG ELECTRONICS STRENGTHENS GLOBAL SUPPLY CHAIN FOR ADVANCED ANTIMICROBIAL MATERIALS. *New Production Line in Vietnam to Meet Growing B2B Demand for Advanced Materials, Including PuroTec™ and Easy-Clean Enamel*. * LG Electronics  has launched a new production line for glass powder-based materials at its manufacturing facility in Haiphong, Vietnam. * The line will produce approximately 2,000 tons of materials annually, including LG PuroTec™ and Easy-Clean Enamel. * The dual-plant system in Changwon and Haiphong will help ensure a stable supply for global clients and enhance delivery responsiveness. SEOUL, South Korea , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LG Electronics (LG) is strengthening its global supply chain for advanced glass powder-based materials with the launch of a new production line at its manufacturing facility in Haiphong, Vietnam. The new line will produce key materials including LG PuroTec™ and Easy-Clean Enamel while serving as a key production hub for LG's growing advanced materials business. The Haiphong plant adds 2,000 tons of annual glass powder production capacity to LG's manufacturing network.
